source_id: BW-IWD-01 - Complaint Intake and Assessment Path
purpose: Verify workflow path from initial complaint creation through submission to under review.
action_or_input: Execute sequential transition: draft -> submit -> review.
expected_result: Each step succeeds; submitted_at timestamp recorded; final status is 'under_review'.

source_id: BW-IWD-03 / BW-IWD-04 - Hold for Review Path
purpose: Verify workflow hold path when committee review or additional clarification is needed.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/iwd/requests/{id}/hold/ with reason 'Awaiting material sample tests'.
expected_result: Status transitions to 'on_hold'; workflow is paused.

purpose: Verify workflow resumption from on_hold to in_progress or under_review.
expected_result: Transition is permitted by state machine; status becomes 'in_progress'.

source_id: CW-IWD-01 - Estimate Approval Routing Guard Check

source_id: CW-IWD-03 - Work Completion and Verification Boundary
purpose: Verify closing a work request permanently terminates its lifecycle.

expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; terminal state cannot transition.
